name: Baja SAE
mission: We design, build and race a single-seat off-road vehicle for the Baja SAE collegiate series: frame, suspension, steering, braking and drivetrain, built by students in Boston College's shops.
overview: Baja SAE gives every team the same engine, so the result comes down to engineering decisions rather than power. The vehicle is judged through design reviews, cost analysis, dynamic events and a four-hour endurance race, where reliability and execution decide who finishes.
objectives: Build a vehicle that survives rough terrain and a multi-hour endurance race
Take the whole design, build and test cycle through student hands
Defend the design and its cost in front of judges

name: AeroEagles
mission: AeroEagles will design, manufacture, test, launch and safely recover a reusable high-powered rocket carrying an autonomous payload. After landing, the payload finds a passive visual target and measures its distance without GPS.
overview: The team is working toward NASA Student Launch 2027 with Baldwin-1, a single-stage vehicle with three sections tethered through descent and one central avionics bay. Every flight feeds a model-to-test loop: predict the flight, fly it, compare, and update the next design.
objectives: Launch and safely recover a reusable high-power rocket
Carry an autonomous payload that ranges a passive visual target without GPS
Treat recovery as mission-critical, with independent checks before every flight
